title: Agnus Dei (Sohier, Missa Vidi speciosam)
desc: Mathieu Sohier, Missa Vidi speciosam, Agnus Dei, 1556. 6 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Quintus, Tenor 1, Tenor 2, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0002_5); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
